label: Speed ratio
help: 1 = unchanged, 0.5 = octave down and twice as long

label: Semitones
help: 12 = octave up (half as long), -12 = octave down

label: Accel
help: speed ratio reached at Goal time (below 1 = slow down)

label: Goal time
help: time in the output (s) where Accel is reached

label: Scatter
help: randomisation of cuts; 0 = reorder without shredding

label: Sample rate division
help: rounded to a power of 2; 1 = unchanged

label: Gate
help: level at which the attack is recognised (0 to 1)

label: Approx time
help: attack at max level within 200 ms of this time (s)

label: Loudness
help: of the scaled copy, relative to 1

label: Octave range
help: maximum transposition up or down, in octaves

label: Max cycles
help: max wavesets between new transposition values

label: Frequency limit
help: Hz; only wavesets below it count

label: Join time
help: s, where the join is cut

label: Delay
help: s between iterations (not longer than the segment)

label: Lean
help: level of top copy relative to bottom

label: Proportion
help: how much of the output to make, 0 to 1
